name: Cloudflare Google OAuth MCP Server
description: A remote MCP server deployable on Cloudflare Workers that provides integrated Google OAuth authentication for secure tool access. It serves as a reference implementation for building persistent, authenticated MCP connections using Cloudflare Durable Objects and Streamable HTTP.
